name: spotify-launcher
local_adaptations: Use the native at-spi2-core dependency and declare CA certificates, CMake and pkgconf.
Keep Cargo caches/output inside the recipe; fetch locked inputs in prepare and build/test frozen.
Retain mandatory Spotify runtime libraries, source signatures, verification keyring, config, icons and licensing.
known_failure: Provided log stops during isolated root dependency installation with FileConflicts and omits conflicting paths; no recipe change can establish that conflict is resolved without a worker retry.
